headline: Apple to scan shared iCloud links for 'harmful content'
summary: Apple says it will begin checking iCloud items shared via public links for 'harmful content' starting with iOS 27.3 and related updates. The Register notes Apple has not defined what counts as harmful content, and frames the move critically as turning iCloud into a 'spy cloud.'

claims.statement: Apple will scan publicly shared iCloud links for 'harmful content' starting with iOS 27.3.
